## Fixes

- `agentport setup` no longer refuses a server running agentport v0.1.0. The
  minimum remote version inherited from AgentClip (v0.5.0) is now v0.1.0, so
  setup completes and creates the profile.
- Installs and upgrades of v0.1.x now require and verify the GitHub build
  attestation instead of reporting that the release "predates build
  attestations".

If `agentport setup` failed with "older than v0.5.0", reinstall with the install
script or `brew upgrade agentport`, then run `agentport setup` again.
